# Lakeshore Capital x AbarVa AI Success Platform Brief - Source

Created: 2026-06-05

Purpose: buyer-facing reading page for Surekha / Lakeshore. This is not a generic architecture deck. It explains why AbarVa can help a Lakeshore-style private holdings company make AI transformation, treasury modernization, Kyriba rollout de-risking, and cross-HoldCo operating improvement successful.

## Page Thesis

AbarVa is not Claude with a nicer UI. Claude can reason. AbarVa makes the reasoning operational: tenant context, evidence, corpus patterns, role/persona framing, governed workflows, approval state, persisted artifacts, and value proof.

Kyriba is the best opening wedge because it is concrete, finance-owned, measurable, and failure-prone. The broader value is larger: once Lakeshore loads CXO operating context across HoldCos, the same system can govern treasury, IT reporting, vendor consolidation, cyber risk, board reporting, platform rollouts, growth AI use cases, and AI use-case reuse.

Anchor sentence:

> AbarVa helps Lakeshore decide which AI opportunities matter, execute them with evidence and controls, and prove which ones create real value.

## Claim Discipline

Use these labels visibly:

- Live production proof: screenshots and route crawls captured against app.abarva.ai.
- Loader-backed: data loaded through AbarVa setup / app data paths.
- Planning baseline: realistic Lakeshore working profile pending client validation.
- Generated draft: AI-assisted artifact that still requires human review.
- Forecast: modeled value, not realized savings.
- Not yet proven: intended capability that lacks current proof.

Do not claim realized savings, real client confidential data, enterprise SSO, or live Azure Search load unless direct evidence exists.

## Target Reader Outcome

After reading, Surekha should believe:

1. AbarVa understands the operating reality of a diversified private holdings company.
2. AbarVa can start with the most important priority, such as Kyriba / treasury modernization, without reducing the vision to one tool rollout.
3. AbarVa has real product surfaces already working: Setup, Intelligence, Moves, Source, Tower.
4. AbarVa makes AI safer and more useful by binding it to evidence, workflow, approvals, and value proof.
5. AbarVa can become a living intelligence layer that improves as Lakeshore edits doctrine, loads more evidence, and runs more Moves.
6. A 6-month engagement can produce tangible operating assets, not just strategy slides.

- Treasury content is expanded into decision-grade doctrine: daily cash position, bank connectivity, ERP/GL feeds, entity hierarchy, intercompany lending, covenant forecasting, payment controls, cash pooling, FX, and ASC 815.
- Kyriba wedge section now gives the screenshot full page width and adds gate-level substance: checks, artifacts, failure modes, and the data Lakeshore must load before the first steering decision.
- Corpus is positioned as editable and governed, not a static generated artifact.
- Added a six-month value case that explains how the $500K investment can be justified through 5-10x value potential: Kyriba failure-cost avoidance, banking rationalization, vendor leverage, IT/app rationalization, risk controls, execution-cost reduction, and reusable AI use cases.
- Kyriba remains the wedge, but the larger story is AI-led growth, cost optimization, risk control, and portfolio execution.

## Lakeshore Profile Claim Discipline

The brief uses the Lakeshore planning profile as a working baseline:

- Lakeshore Holdings parent / sponsor layer.
- Modeled operating platforms: Northshore Supply & Logistics, Northshore BrandWorks, Northshore Consumer Products, Northshore Workplace Services.
- Planning scale: ~$3B revenue, ~10k employees, four modeled operating platforms, and potential 50-country footprint.
- Archetype basis: fictionalized Lakeshore/Northshore profile is directionally modeled on the public Chicago private-holdings pattern of supply chain/logistics, packaging/sourcing, brand services, consumer products, and convenience/workplace services. It does not copy or represent any real Morgan Street operating company.
- Business economics modeled: supply-chain programs make money through distribution margin, packaging/sourcing spread, service fees, and logistics efficiency; brand services through campaign/program fees, fulfillment margin, promotional sourcing, and analytics; consumer products through wholesale/DTC margin, pricing, and inventory turns; workplace services through route density, location profitability, replenishment efficiency, and payment capture.
- Typical challenges modeled: working-capital drag, transportation cost volatility, supplier concentration, bank fragmentation, ERP/TMS/WMS integration gaps, margin leakage, contract scope creep, route labor cost, cash controls, vendor overlap, customer concentration, and board-grade value proof.
- Corporate strategy modeled: deepen customer relationships, protect service quality, modernize systems, reduce vendor and banking fragmentation, and turn shared operating capabilities into repeatable AI-enabled value across the portfolio.

During kickoff, confirm or replace: actual company roster, revenue, EBITDA, employees, countries, banking estate, systems, vendors, programs, and board priorities.

## Commercial Close

Frame the 6-month ask as a governed execution partnership:

- Month 1: load and validate Lakeshore, HoldCo, CXO, systems, vendor, contract, CMDB, and process context.
- Month 2: build editable corpus doctrine for treasury, finance, governance, vendor, IT, risk, and operating-company execution.
- Month 3: run Kyriba / treasury readiness gates and first board-grade evidence pack.
- Month 4: launch Source value events for banks, SI, audit/advisory, vendor overlap, and renewal optimization.
- Month 5: move 3-5 opportunities through execution with artifacts, owners, and approvals.
- Month 6: publish Tower value ledger, corpus coverage, board narrative, operating model, and renewal case.

Close line:

AbarVa helps Lakeshore decide what to do next, what evidence supports it, what is still missing, who must approve it, and how the value will be proven.
